detailed_description: The Emoji Picker is a small browser-side picker over a built-in emoji list. It exposes nine category buttons (smileys, people, animals, food, travel, activities, objects, symbols, flags) plus All, a search input that does case-insensitive substring matching on the emoji name or character, a grid of matching emojis, and a recent-emojis row of up to 16 entries that updates after each click. Clicking an emoji copies it to the clipboard and briefly highlights it. The dataset is the bundled emoji list, not the full Unicode CLDR catalog, and there is no fuzzy search, hex code lookup, skin-tone selector, ARIA keyboard navigation, or cross-session persistence.
usage_steps: Type a keyword in the search input to filter emojis whose name or character contains the query
Or click All or one of the nine category buttons to filter the grid
Hover an emoji to see its English name in the tooltip
Click an emoji to copy it to the clipboard and see the briefly highlighted state
Re-use a recently copied emoji from the recent row above the grid
Clear the search input or pick another category to browse different emojis
usage_examples: Quickly grab a smiley or thumbs-up emoji while writing a chat message
Search by keyword like pizza or airplane to copy a single emoji into a document
Browse the symbols category to copy a check mark for a checklist
Re-use a few recently copied emojis from the recent row while drafting social posts
